Jazz Jams at Jupiter

July 08, 2026
7:00 PM - 10:00 PM

Jupiter

2181 Shattuck Avenue, Berkeley

Join us every Wednesday at Jupiter in Downtown Berkeley for The Jazzschool Jazz Jams.

Bring your instrument and friends, and join the fun. The Jazzschool faculty leads the house band—come play, listen, or simply enjoy some tasty eats and great music! Free and open to all ages!

Visit jupiterbeer.com to see the menu, get directions, or learn more about Jupiter.
